name: GameMode
description: The rules of a level: the one object that decides how play starts, who joins and when it ends. A level selects its game mode in World Settings.

methods.name: on_game_start
methods.doc: Called once when play begins, before any actor's begin_play.

methods.name: on_player_joined
methods.doc: Called when a player enters the game, before their controller and character are spawned.
